name: Runner Extras - HTTP Egress Boundary OOS
brief: Issue #2547: AL's HTTP mocking ([HttpClientHandler]) runs here, and REAL egress is refused at NavHttpClient.SendAsync(HttpRequestMessage) -- the one method every send funnels through after BC's mock dispatcher declines. target=OnPrem is required: the [HttpClientHandler] attribute has scope OnPrem, so a Cloud-target app cannot declare one (error AL0296).
description: Two of these four tests are plain BC behaviour and would normally live upstream in the al-language corpus. They cannot: that app targets Cloud and the AL compiler rejects [HttpClientHandler] there with 'error AL0296: The application object or method HttpClientHandler has scope OnPrem and cannot be used for Cloud development' -- measured, after an earlier draft of the corpus PR carried them and would not compile. The half the corpus CAN express is upstream as codeunit 60318 (StefanMaron/BusinessCentral.AL.Language.Tests), and TestHttpClient.al covers the absent-policy case. The other two tests here are runner-specific by construction: what the runner does when BC hands a request onward to be sent for real (refuse by name, external-http), and the scoping control that this refusal must NOT fire under BlockOutboundRequests, where BC's own error is the faithful answer.
